exposure: prolonged latent first stage of labor
cohort: 484 women who underwent labor induction at referral hospitals in Amhara National Regional State, Ethiopia
finding: The prevalence of failed induction of labor was 31.4% (95% CI: 27.0, 36.0), and was independently predicted by a Bishop score of <=5, prolonged latent first stage of labor, induction with oxytocin alone, nulliparity, post term pregnancy and hypertensive disorder of pregnancy.
